Applying cost = fair_value to the missing-cost rows changes 2025-12-31 cost_sum from 402,991,550 to 314,170,238 versus the cost anchor 314,145,189, reducing the cost residual from 28.2819% to 0.0080%.

rationale: The target fair-value schedule already reconciles because holdings include the negative unfunded loan commitment line. The remaining held-out conservation failure is in cost: the same rows that carry valid fair values have NULL cost, including the contra unfunded commitment. For cash-like and commitment contra rows where the filing presents no separate per-row cost but the net schedule cost differs from gross by the same commitment amount, setting missing cost equal to fair_value restores the filer net cost within rounding tolerance and does not change fair value.
